calls.statement:
WITH h AS (SELECT DISTINCT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id=15),
m AS (SELECT h.member_id, d.marketing_consent, d.join_date, d.tier FROM h LEFT JOIN dim_member d ON d.member_id=h.member_id AND DATE '2025-11-24' BETWEEN d.valid_from AND d.valid_to)
SELECT count(*) n, count(marketing_consent) matched, sum(CASE WHEN marketing_consent THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) consent_true, sum(CASE WHEN marketing_consent=false THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) consent_false, sum(CASE WHEN join_date>DATE '2025-11-24' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) joined_after,
(SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member WHERE DATE '2025-11-24' BETWEEN valid_from AND valid_to AND marketing_consent) eligible_consent,
(SELECT count(DISTINCT member_key) FROM fact_campaign_exposure WHERE campaign_id=15) exposed_keys,
(SELECT count(DISTINCT m2.member_id) FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m2 USING(member_key) WHERE e.campaign_id=15) exposed_members,
(SELECT count(DISTINCT m2.member_id) FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m2 USING(member_key) JOIN h ON h.member_id=m2.member_id WHERE e.campaign_id=15) held_and_exposed
FROM m

calls.statement:
WITH h AS (SELECT DISTINCT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id=15),
m AS (SELECT h.member_id, d.marketing_consent AS mc, d.join_date AS jd, d.tier FROM h LEFT JOIN dim_member d ON d.member_id=h.member_id AND DATE '2025-11-24' BETWEEN d.valid_from AND d.valid_to)
SELECT count(*) AS n, count(mc) AS matched, sum(CASE WHEN mc THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS consent_true, sum(CASE WHEN mc=false THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS consent_false, sum(CASE WHEN jd>DATE '2025-11-24' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS joined_after,
(SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member WHERE DATE '2025-11-24' BETWEEN valid_from AND valid_to AND marketing_consent) AS eligible_consent,
(SELECT count(DISTINCT member_key) FROM fact_campaign_exposure WHERE campaign_id=15) AS exposed_keys,
(SELECT count(DISTINCT m2.member_id) FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m2 USING(member_key) WHERE e.campaign_id=15) AS exposed_members,
(SELECT count(DISTINCT m2.member_id) FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m2 USING(member_key) JOIN h ON h.member_id=m2.member_id WHERE e.campaign_id=15) AS held_and_exposed
FROM m
